title: Kingo
notice: You compete on how many matching numbers you collect — the total does not matter
label.betPrompt: Place a bet ({{min}} or more, in steps of 10)
label.dealPrompt: The bets are in — deal to continue
tutorial.rule: You compete on how many cards of the same number you collect. Oicho-Kabu scores the last digit of a total; this is a different game
tutorial.bet: The bet goes in before anything is dealt. No hand exists yet, so there is nothing to read
tutorial.banker: The banker does not bet — it takes every child's stake. The bank moves one seat each round
frontendHint.kingoNoInformationYet: nothing is dealt yet, so the amount is yours to choose
frontendHint.kingoStackIsShort: your stack is short, so the minimum is the safe call
frontendHint.kingoYouAreTheBanker: the banker does not bet — deal to continue
